races.name: Hakari
races.racial: Quick : Hakari characters can run without moving first and can sacrifice a STANDARD action to refresh their QUICK action.
races.evolution: Predator: Hakari no SKILL penalties in darkness and have natural retracteable claws (see CLAWS Melee weapons for stats)
races.environment: Fight or Flight : MAINTENANCE SAVES rolls are unlucky while suffering from TRAUMA but gain 1 surge point to be used in the same round if they do succeed.

races.name: Human
races.racial: Dormant Potential : Humans start the game with one TIER 1 EVO trait of their choice. This trait is free, does not count against your EVO trait limit and stays with your character even if you get cloned.
races.evolution: Specialized: At character creation, pick a skill; all rolls made with that skill have a SMALL bonus and +1 to CRITICAL range.
races.environment: Instability : Humans have a limited genetic code; their bodies do not adapt to EVO's very well. Any EVO's not in the same category as the one picked at character creation cost 50% more credits and EVO affliction rolls when installing are UNLUCKY.

races.name: Jaulaus
races.racial: Reptilian metabolism : Jaulaus regenerate 1 HEALTH every maintenance as long as they are not suffering from HEAVY TRAUMA.
races.evolution: Redundant Organs: Jaulaus have redundant vital locations and ignore the attribute penality of all HEALTH based TRAUMA.
races.environment: Bad eyesight : Jaulaus have poor eyesight: Ranged skill checks are UNLUCKY at MEDIUM and LONG range.

races.name: Skalander
races.racial: Armored Skin: Skalander natural armor provides grants them resistance to STUN damage. Your ENDURANCE SOAK rolls are guaranteed against STUN damage.
races.evolution: The Veil : Skalander SOCIAL skills have a SMALL bonus against all enemies within 10m.
races.environment: Shared Suffering: While in combat allies within your Veil range have a SMALL bonus to ENDURANCE checks. This bonus is lost if any of your allies is downed.

races.name: Patriark
races.racial: Immortal : Patriarks do not age, are imune to the effects of poisons and ignore the effects of Lifebane.
races.evolution: The Veil : Your social skills have a SMALL bonus against non hostiles targets that can see you within 10m.
races.environment: Reincarnate : Patriark do not recover HEALTH or MORALE from a REST. Should a Patriark die; they can posess a willing ally within 10m, this counts as a backup. While posessing a host, the Patriark's can share his knowledge and skills. Should the host die, the Patriark is DESTROYED.

races.name: Nerulian
races.racial: Blood of Aiur : +2 to maximum CHI and your TOXICITY rolls are LUCKY.
races.evolution: Graceful : Moving over difficult terrain does not incur a MOVEMENT penalty.
races.environment: Sinister Reputation : Most of the galaxy hates and fears you: When performing SOCIAL skills you gain a SMALL penality when trying to do something nice or neutral but a SMALL bonus when its used to coerce people.

races.name: Psylon
races.racial: Eternal : Psylons do not age, eat, drink, sleep or grow old. You still need to rest 6-8 hours a day and be in contact with some form of energy to nourish yourself (sunlight, electricity, radiation etc).
races.evolution: Implacable : As a QUICK reaction a PSYLON can add their WILLPOWER to the mitigation or damage roll of a MORALE attack target within 10m.
races.environment: Alien Body : All ENERGY damage is reduced to STUN damage. Your internals are quite fragile; Psylons have vulnerability 1 to PHYSICAL damage.

races.racial: AI Born : Your maximum CHI is always 0. You can run without moving first and can sacrifice a STANDARD action to refresh their QUICK action. You do not count as a HAKARI for BACKGROUND selection.
